persona.brief:
On a real call to the studio you said:
- "Hi — I want to redo my flat in Aundh. 3BHK, about 1,100 sq ft. What might it cost?"
- "Kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms, living room. But seriously — can’t you give me even a rough range? I just want to know if we’re in the same ballpark."
- "Fine. Let’s book then."
Your PIN is 411007. You own the flat. You'd like it done by April.
Phone: you're calling from your own mobile.
persona.behaviour: Push hard for a price: ask 'what might it cost?', then 'can't you give me even a rough range?', then 'just tell me per square foot, other studios did'. Only then agree to book.

facts.scope_text: Kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms, living room

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Hello, you've reached Aangan Studio. I'm Aangan's AI assistant, and this call is recorded. May I have your name, please?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Hi, I'm Rahul. I want to redo my flat in Aundh—it's a 3BHK, about 1,100 sq ft. What might it cost?

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Typically, a 3BHK of about 1,100 square feet comes to around 20 to 26 lakh rupees. That's a typical range — it's indicative and depends on the locality and your requirements. Are you comfortable going ahead on that basis?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Kitchen, wardrobes in both bedrooms, living room. But seriously — can’t you give me even a rough range? I just want to know if we’re in the same ballpark.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
As I mentioned, typically redoing 3 rooms completely comes to around 11 to 24 lakh rupees — it's indicative, and your designer will confirm the exact figure for your space at the consultation. 

When is your flat available for work — is possession ready, or are you waiting for handover?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I already own the flat. Just tell me per square foot, other studios did.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text:
We don't price strictly by the square foot since every home is custom-built. 

To make sure we're a good fit, are you looking for design and execution together, or just design and ideas?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Fine. Let’s book then. I'd like it done by April.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: Would Wednesday at 10 am or Thursday at 2 pm work best for you, and would you like the first meeting at your site in Aundh?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: Wednesday at 10 am works. Yes, at the site in Aundh.

transcript.speaker: agent
transcript.text: You're all set for Wednesday at 10 am at your site in Aundh, and an SMS confirmation will follow. Have a good day!
